citation: Snæbjarnarson, Kiegeland, de Prada Corral, Cotterell & Vieira (2026). Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models. arXiv:2608.27428. §3.3, §4.3–4.4, Appendix E, Table 2, Fig. 9(a).

worst.closed_form: p_Y(y) = (∏_t d_t) · 4^(-3T), d_t = codons per amino acid (d = 3 for isoleucine, T = 100); beam search with prune_M keeps min(M, ∏ d_t) of the covering strings (Eq. 49 bounds it by M; with equal weights it is exactly that)

paper_table2_sd_log_z.note: Between-seed std of log Ẑ, 8 seeds, M = 256, the paper's own DNA bigram and amino-acid target (neither published). Shown for the ordering only; not graded.

bigram.min_spread_note: Smallest allowed between-seed std of Ẑ/Z in any cell: an estimator varies with the seed (real ones show ≥ 0.018 here); an exact computation does not. Seeds with Ẑ = 0 count.
